title: 第25章 怪肉第26章 漏
content_zh:
黑蛇觉得这东西应该可以食用。
忆起猎户用短刀分割野猪肉的过程，将庞大猎物分成便于吞咽的小块肉，非常值得模仿学习。
既然此物没有威胁，或许可以尝试如何切割。
目光锁定泛白类似肉的组织，吐了吐信子。
猛地突袭张嘴咬上去，没办法，改不了快速突袭的本能。
怪异肥肉没有反应。
咬住是咬住了，黑蛇能确保猎物无法挣脱，随之而来的却是前所未有的困惑，该如何撕下能吞咽的肉块？哪里的肌肉该发力？
呆愣片刻，试着左右晃动，有点效果，似乎松动了些，但远未到能撕开的程度。
略一思索改为往后拽，这次好像感觉口中肉块松动，既然此法有效便持续发力，并仔细感知哪个部位肌肉发力，调集自身清凉气息往发力处汇聚。
此法果然好使，涌现远超平常的力道。
怪东西质地没有肉那么坚韧，黑蛇拽下来一块白花花肥肉组织，肌肉熟练的蠕动顺畅吞咽。
稍微停顿仔细品味。
没有寻常血肉的腥气，味道出乎意料的平和，能够获得饱腹感，且并无任何异样。
能吃。
再次以雷霆之势死死咬住怪东西，躯体用力往后撕扯。
硬生生扯下大块颤巍巍的组织，技巧越来越熟练，喉部肌肉蠕动顺畅吞咽。
没有其它走兽飞禽觊觎，黑蛇独自享用。
两丈有余修长蛇躯刚刚完成蜕皮，正处在对能量最渴求的关头，这块怪肉出现的恰到好处，看似庞大，但盘踞缠绕的黑蛇亦不小，且拥有远超同类近乎贪婪的消化能力。
黑蛇从容不迫，每一次撕咬和吞咽都缓慢稳定，沉浸在自己的事情里。
无所谓白昼与黑夜变幻。

深夜，月光照亮山间小盆地，风吹不尽淤泥腐朽气息。
黑蛇停下吞咽缓缓抬头，折射月光的竖瞳沉默迎向山林，锁定森林阴影走出来的一对光点。
山猫远远止步，观察怪异肉块与漆黑大蛇。
它小心翼翼，谨慎审视远超认知的庞大黑蛇，内心权衡是否有必要招惹。
生存本能警告它应该远离异常黑蛇。
山猫转身离开，并将风带来的大黑蛇气味深深烙在记忆里。
黑蛇确认代表山猫的热源远去，冰冷竖瞳缓缓扫视四周，确认再无威胁，这才重新俯首继续撕咬肉块吞咽。
清凉气息被精准调动，流转汇入头颅，在这股特殊能量加持下，撕扯与吞咽变得愈发高效。
不停地吃……
月亮从这边山峦悄然滑至另一座山。
几头早起的野猪吭哧吭哧，从林中毫无顾忌蹿出。
黑蛇看见野猪就很无语，野猪是为数不多能留下点印象的走兽，只因这些莽货全然不懂权衡与谨慎，只会一根筋横冲直撞，近视眼已经能看见灰褐色身影，就很愁。
怪肉所剩无几，黑蛇冷漠注视对方动向，弓身摆出警告姿态。
这江河附近与丰茂的草甸小盆地，真是什么都能撞见。
大大小小野猪们发现了怪肉，以及在旁边盘踞的大黑蛇，吭哧吭哧聚过来，粗糙鼻子耸动，不停往前接近试探，像是在争论对方能不能吃。
距离越来越近，混合松脂的泥土味扑面而来！
content_en:
Black Snake thought this thing should be edible.
Recalling the process of hunters using short knives to cut wild boar meat, the huge prey is divided into small pieces of meat that are easy to swallow. It is worth imitating and learning.
Since this thing is not a threat, maybe you can try how to cut it.
He locked his eyes on the white flesh-like tissue and spat out a message.
He suddenly pounced and opened his mouth to bite him. There was nothing he could do to change his instinct to pounce quickly.
Weird Fatty didn't respond.
The bite is a bite. The black snake can ensure that the prey cannot break free, but what follows is unprecedented confusion. How to tear off pieces of meat that can be swallowed? Where should the muscles work?
After being stunned for a moment, I tried shaking it from side to side, and it had some effect. It seemed to be loosened a little, but it was far from enough to tear it apart.
After a moment's thought, I changed to pulling back. This time, I felt that the meat in my mouth was loose. Since this method is effective, I continued to exert force, and carefully sensed which part of the muscle was exerting force, and mobilized my own cool breath to gather at the point of exertion.
This method really works, and the strength is far beyond ordinary.
The texture of the strange thing was not as tough as meat. The black snake pulled off a piece of white fat tissue and swallowed it smoothly with skilled muscle movements.
Pause for a moment and savor.
There is no fishy smell of ordinary flesh and blood, the taste is unexpectedly mild, it can make you feel full, and there is nothing strange about it.
Can be eaten.
Once again, he bit the strange thing with the power of thunder, and tore the body back with all his strength.
He forcefully pulled off a large piece of trembling tissue, his technique became more and more proficient, and his throat muscles wriggled to swallow smoothly.
No other animals or birds covet it, and the black snake enjoys it alone.
The slender body of the snake, which was more than two feet long, had just finished shedding its skin and was at the moment when it was most thirsty for energy. This piece of strange meat appeared at the right time. It seemed huge, but the entangled black snake was not small, and it had an almost greedy digestion ability that far exceeded that of its kind.
The black snake took its time, every bite and swallow was slow and steady, immersed in its own affairs.
There is no difference between day and night.
Late at night, the moonlight illuminates the small basin in the mountains, and the wind cannot blow away the smell of mud and decay.
The black snake stopped swallowing and slowly raised its head. Its vertical pupils that reflected the moonlight silently faced the mountain forest, locking on a pair of light spots coming out of the shadow of the forest.
The lynx stayed far away, observing the strange pieces of meat and the big black snake.
It carefully examined the huge black snake that was far beyond its cognition, and internally weighed whether it was necessary to provoke it.
Survival instinct warns it to stay away from the unusual black snake.
The lynx turned away, searing the smell of the big black snake brought by the wind into its memory.
The black snake confirmed that the heat source representing the lynx had gone away. Its cold vertical eyes slowly scanned the surroundings to confirm that there was no longer a threat. Then it lowered its head again and continued to bite the meat and swallow it.
The cool breath was precisely mobilized and flowed into the head. With the blessing of this special energy, tearing and swallowing became more efficient.
Keep eating...
The moon slides quietly from the mountains here to the other mountain.
A few wild boars that got up early jumped out of the forest without hesitation.
Black Snake was speechless when he saw the wild boar. The wild boar is one of the few animals that can leave some impression. It's just because these fools don't know how to weigh and be cautious. They can only run wildly. With myopia, they can already see the gray-brown figure, which makes them very worried.
There was not much monster meat left, and the black snake watched the opponent's movements indifferently, bowing its body in a warning posture.
You can find everything near the river and the lush meadow basin.
The wild boars, big and small, discovered the strange meat and the big black snake entrenched nearby. They came together with a squeaking sound, their rough noses twitching, and they kept moving forward to test it, as if they were debating whether the other party could eat it.
The distance is getting closer and closer, and the earthy smell mixed with rosin hits your face!
